biomarkers.name: ARID1A
biomarkers.clinical_use: Frequent loss-of-function alteration; SWI/SNF complex; supports diagnosis in context but is not specific

biomarkers.name: Napsin A, HNF1B
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic panel for clear cell subtype

biomarkers.name: MSI / dMMR
biomarkers.clinical_use: Predicts benefit from immune checkpoint blockade if MSI-H/dMMR; prompts Lynch syndrome workup when present

biomarkers.name: PD-L1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Not an established subtype-specific standard biomarker; may support immunotherapy decision-making in selected settings depending on regimen/tumor context

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.clinical_use: Wild-type TP53 pattern is typical and helps distinguish from high-grade serous carcinoma

biomarkers.name: PPP2R1A
biomarkers.clinical_use: Recurrent somatic driver seen in a subset of ovarian clear cell carcinomas

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Clear cells with hobnail features arranged in tubulocystic, papillary, or solid patterns; hyaline stromal globules characteristic
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Considered a high-grade carcinoma by conventional ovarian grading concepts, although the classic HGSC 2-tier grading system is not routinely applied to clear cell carcinoma; Ki-67 is often lower than in HGSC

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: A minority show MSI-H/dMMR (~2-10%) and may represent a more inflamed subset; PD-L1 expression is variable
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Distinctive hyalinised basement membrane-like stromal deposits ('hyaline globules')

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Endometriosis-associated (often arising from ovarian endometriotic cysts) with distinct genital tract Müllerian origin
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — Müllerian-related epithelium through endometriotic implants
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Clear cell / hobnail differentiation (HNF-1β+, napsin A+, PAX8+, WT1-negative — distinct from serous); glycogen-rich cytoplasm
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Endometriotic cyst → atypical endometriosis → clear cell carcinoma progression; ARID1A loss is an early and characteristic event affecting SWI/SNF chromatin remodelling
